packageTour.title: 10 Days | 09 Nights Ramayana Trail Tour
inclusions: Meeting at the airport upon arrival and assistance
packageTour.description: Explore Sri Lanka with our 10 Days | 09 Nights Ramayana Trail Tour. This tour covers Airport - Negombo, Negombo - Chilaw - Anuradhapura, Anuradhapura - Trincomalee, Trincomalee - Dambulla - Kandy, Kandy - Peradeniya - Pinnawala - Kandy, Kandy - Ramboda - Nuwara Eliya, Nuwara Eliya - Hakgala - Ella - Kataragama, Kataragama - Ussangoda - Balapitiya - Colombo, Galle | Hikkaduwa - Balapitiya - Colombo, Colombo - City Tour - Airport. Experience the rich culture, breathtaking landscapes, and warm hospitality of Sri Lanka with our professional chauffeur-guided service.

itinerary.title: Airport - Negombo
itinerary.description: Transfer to hotel in Negombo. Overnight stay at Negombo.

itinerary.title: Negombo - Chilaw - Anuradhapura
itinerary.description: Visit Munneswaram & Manavari Hindu Temples. Overnight stay at Anuradhapura.

itinerary.title: Anuradhapura - Trincomalee
itinerary.description: Visit Anuradhapura Kingdom and Thirukoneswaram Hindu Temple. Overnight stay at Trincomalee.

itinerary.title: Trincomalee - Dambulla - Kandy
itinerary.description: Visit Dambulla Cave Temple and Temple of the Tooth. Overnight stay at Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Peradeniya - Pinnawala - Kandy
itinerary.description: Visit Botanical Garden and Elephant Orphanage. Overnight stay at Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy - Ramboda - Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Visit Sri Bhaktha Hanuman Temple and Tea Factory. Overnight stay at Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya - Hakgala - Ella - Kataragama
itinerary.description: Visit Ashok Vatika, Sita Amman Temple and Divurumpola. Overnight stay at Kataragama.

itinerary.title: Kataragama - Ussangoda - Balapitiya - Colombo
itinerary.description: Visit Kataragama Temple, Ussangoda site and Galle Fort. Overnight stay at Galle.

itinerary.title: Galle | Hikkaduwa - Balapitiya - Colombo
itinerary.description: Madu River Boat Ride and Kelaniya Vibhishana Temple. Overnight stay in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Colombo - City Tour - Airport
itinerary.description: City tour in Colombo. Transfer to Airport.

dayTrip.title: Sigiriya Rock Fortress & Dambulla
dayTrip.description: Climb the majestic Sigiriya Lion Rock and explore the ancient Dambulla Cave Temple. A journey through Sri Lanka's rich history and stunning landscapes.
